metadata.description: A Claude Code skill for starting and auditing repositories, running the daily branch-to-pull-request routine, and undoing git mistakes safely

plugins.name: repo-kickoff
plugins.description: Start a new repository, locally and as a private GitHub repo, whose setup can be reproduced and checked, with a pre-commit gate that blocks common API keys and passwords; audit an existing repo's README, requirements, .gitignore and committed secrets; carry a task from branch to merged pull request (Daily mode); diagnose and undo git mistakes after your OK (Undo mode).
